bagPolicy.summary: Purses and bags are allowed but will be searched. Backpacks are not allowed, and items such as pocket knives, pepper spray, flasks and outside food or drinks are prohibited.
bagPolicy.quote: Purses and bags are allowed, but will be searched. Backpacks are not allowed.

parking.summary: There is ample free parking near Songbyrd in the Union Market area.
parking.quote: There is ample free parking near Songbyrd in the Union Market area

rideshare.summary: Concerto couldn't find a rideshare pickup zone published by Songbyrd Music House. Set your pickup to the venue's address. After the show, use any signed pickup area, or walk a block or two from the main exit before you request a ride so your driver can reach you.

concessions.summary: Songbyrd has a full food and drink menu. At the venue you can pay by credit card, debit card or cash. Outside food and drinks are not allowed.
concessions.quote: Other purchases at the venue can be made via credit card, debit card or cash.

accessibility.summary: All customer areas are wheelchair accessible, with an ADA restroom stall and gender-neutral restrooms. Most shows are standing room with some barstools on request, and ADA seating is limited, so email info@songbyrddc.com ahead of time, especially for sold-out shows.
accessibility.quote: If you want to plan in advance, you can contact us at info@songbyrddc.com

reEntry.summary: Re-entry is allowed, so you can step outside to smoke and come back in. Smoking or vaping inside or on the patio gets you removed without readmission.
reEntry.quote: Should you want to smoke, you must exit the building/patio area as we do allow reentry.

ticketPickup.summary: Tickets are sold online through DICE and can be transferred in the DICE app. Walk-up tickets are sold on show night if the show isn't sold out, usually starting about 30 minutes before the show. Everyone needs a valid, non-expired government-issued ID no matter their age, and foreign driver's licenses aren't accepted.
ticketPickup.quote: Yes, you will need to provide a valid ID, no matter how old you are.

gates.summary: Songbyrd Music House hasn't published doors and entry details on its official site. Check your event page or contact the venue before you go.
